NSCB search lists legal name C M D INC, NV Business ID NV20121598818, city Las Vegas NV, four licenses all Active: 0059714 C-3B, 0076020 C-14E, 0079462 C-26B, 0080125 C-19. The four numbers match the ones on cmdnv.com, which lists '59714 is Unlimited', '76020 is Unlimited', '0079462 $1Mil', '80125 Limit $245,000.00'. The site's company phone is (702) 990-4478. C-26B (Building Accessories and Specialties) is the classification that fits partition and accessory installation. cmdnv.com mentions bathroom accessories and specialties but not toilet partitions by name. The search results page gives only summary rows, and I didn't open the License Details page, so bond and limit details come from the company site, not the board. This search did not establish whether the company holds a City of Las Vegas business license, because no public city license lookup was found. A separate company, CMD FINISH CARPENTRY LLC (0092753), is unrelated.
